triage.kind_span: Tekla World Healthcare Fund (the "Trust") is issuing non-transferable rights ("Rights") to its Shareholders of record as of the close of business on March 8, 2021

subject_names.span: Tekla World Healthcare Fund (the "Trust") is issuing non-transferable rights ("Rights") to its Shareholders of record

subject_tickers.span: New York Stock Exchange Symbol: THW

security_class.span: to subscribe for an aggregate of 10,077,635 common shares of beneficial interest ("Shares") of the Trust

rights_per_share.span: You will receive one Right for each whole Share you held as of the Record Date

rights_per_new_share.span: You may subscribe for one Share for every three Rights you hold (the "Primary Subscription")

price_reference.span: a formula equal to 95% of the volume weighted average price of a Share on the NYSE on the date on which the Offer expires

price_pct.span: a formula equal to 95% of the volume weighted average price of a Share on the NYSE on the date on which the Offer expires

price_floor_pct_nav.span: If, however, the Formula Price is less than 90% of the NAV per Share at the close of trading on the NYSE on the Expiration Date (as defined below), then the Subscription Price will be 90% of the Trust's NAV per Share

record_date.span: is issuing to its shareholders of record ("Shareholders") as of the close of business on March 8, 2021 (the "Record Date")

expiration_date.span: which starts on March 16, 2021 and ends at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, on April 6, 2021 (the "Expiration Date")

transferable.span: The Rights are non-transferable, which means that the Rights may not be purchased or sold

over_subscription.span: such Shares which have not been subscribed for will be offered, by means of the Over-Subscription Privilege, to Shareholders who have exercised all the Rights initially issued to them

max_new_shares.span: The Trust is issuing to its Shareholders non-transferable Rights to subscribe for an aggregate of 10,077,635 Shares.

notes: Single document (seq=1), final 424B1 prospectus dated March 4, 2021 for a non-transferable 1-for-3 rights offering. Subscription price = 95% of the 5-day VWAP ending on the Expiration Date, but not less than 90% of NAV per share at the close on the Expiration Date: coded as price_reference=market, price_pct=95, price_floor_pct_nav=90 (economically the greater of 95% of market and 90% of NAV). max_new_shares = 10,077,635 primary shares; the Trust may increase the offer by up to 25% (up to an additional 2,519,409 shares, aggregate 12,597,044) to honor over-subscription requests, excluded from max_new_shares. Subscription period starts March 16, 2021; expiration April 6, 2021 unless extended (only one expiration date stated). Fund type taken from 'The Trust is a non-diversified, closed-end management investment company.'
